referenceSources.title: 1994 Nissan 300ZX V8 IMSA GTS Race Car VIN: 008 - CLASSIC.COM
referenceSources.description:
This 1994 Nissan 300ZX V8 IMSA GTS race car, VIN 008, is finished in a striking red, white, and blue livery with prominent Exxon branding and the racing number 75. It features BBS wheels, Bosch and Yokohama decals, and a large rear wing, all hallmarks of its IMSA GTS competition heritage.

Equipped with a manual transmission, rear-wheel drive, and left-hand drive configuration, the coupe maintains its race-ready setup. Located in Los Angeles County, California, this classic Z-car combines period-correct sponsorship graphics with authentic racecar specifications.
